note: Golden vectors for the pinned canonical AST serialization. `vectors` pin the exact serialization of one statement each; `equivalences` prove that layout, comments, and keyword case cannot move a hash; `distinctions` prove that a semantic change must. A pglast upgrade that changes the parse tree fails here before it can silently roll the surface hash.

vectors.definition: CREATE VIEW example (a, b) AS WITH RECURSIVE chain(entity_id, cur, depth) AS (SELECT entity_id, entity_id, 0 FROM entities UNION ALL SELECT c.entity_id, e.merged_into, c.depth + 1 FROM chain AS c JOIN entities AS e ON e.entity_id = c.cur WHERE e.merged_into IS NOT NULL AND c.depth < 64) SELECT c.entity_id, c.cur FROM chain AS c;
